definitions.explanation: In a way that is easy to see, understand, or prove; without doubt or ambiguity.

examples.japanese: {明|あき}らかに⟦{間違|まちが}っている→間違う：03036_machigau⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{明|あき}らかに⟦{疲|つか}れていた→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{明|あき}らかに⟦{改善|かいぜん}している→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧。

notes:
{明|あき}らかに is the adverbial form of the na-adjective ⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧ (clear, obvious). It means "clearly" or "obviously" and is used when something is evident beyond reasonable doubt.

FORMS:
⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧ (na-adjective) → {明|あき}らかに (adverb)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {明|あき}らかに～だ: is clearly ~
- {明|あき}らかに⟦{違|ちが}う→違う：01957_chigau⟧: clearly different
- {明|あき}らかに⟦{間違|まちが}っている→間違う：03036_machigau⟧: obviously wrong
- {明|あき}らかに⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become clear, to come to light

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦はっきり→はっきり：01228_hakkiri⟧: clearly (more colloquial, also means distinctly)
- ⟦{確|たし}か→確か：00894_tashika⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: certainly, indeed (acknowledges a point)
- ⟦{明確|めいかく}→明確：01664_meikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: clearly, explicitly (more formal, often written)

REGISTER:
Used in both spoken and written Japanese. Slightly more formal than ⟦はっきり→はっきり：01228_hakkiri⟧ but less formal than ⟦{明確|めいかく}→明確：01664_meikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧.
